title: introduce-prefill-policy-auditor-and-quant-antifragility
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: We need a lightweight, auditable path to validate prefill/batching/caching defaults and quantization rollouts before tenant-wide application. This PR adds a prefill policy auditor CLI and a simulated rollout harness that checks unit-econ regressions and quantization antifragility constraints. The auditor runs a tenant replay against the current batch/cache/quant defaults and emits a deterministic report with per-route expected p95 latency, tokens-per-call cost delta, and a quality-signal delta from the eval hooks. It also includes an automated rollback policy generator that produces safe rollback proposals for quantization tiers when the simulated regressions exceed tenant-specific thresholds. Changeset: new CLI binary cmd/prefill-auditor, service library pkg/prefill/auditor that orchestrates replays and heuristics, a pluggable quant rollback evaluator pkg/quant/rollback_policy.go, telemetry wiring telemetry/metrics.yaml and runtime hooks in runtime/prefill_integration.go, plus docs and integration tests. How it works: The auditor accepts a tenant-sample file and a policy spec. It replays the sampled traffic through the serving runtime in a dry-run mode that collects latency and token-cost estimates while exercising KV cache and batch shapes. For quant checks we run an approximate quality estimator that queries the evaluation harness with an abbreviated prompt set. The rollback generator synthesizes an ordered list of fallback quant tiers and a confidence score used by canary rollouts. Rollout path: this artifact is intended to be used by SRE and Cost Ops as a gating step for default changes before tenant-wide application. It is not auto-applied; operators review the auditor report and accept a rollback proposal into a maintenance plan. Backwards compatibility: runtime dry-run mode is additive and guarded by a feature flag, the new CLI is opt-in and requires linear/Jira link in metadata for audit trails. Testing: unit tests for the rollback evaluator, integration test that replays a synthetic tenant trace and asserts expected telemetry keys, and an end-to-end smoke that runs the CLI against a local dev image. See files_changed for details. Related work: ENG-2432 (prefill policy governance), ENG-2499 (quantization rollout safety).

review_comments: Alexei Novak: Can the replay simulate KV cache warmup behavior for multi-tenant shared pools? In particular we saw earlier differences when prefill hits cross-tenant shared caches.

Priya Kapoor: Good question. The simulator models per-tenant cache warmup with a configurable overlap parameter and has a 'shared_pool_mode' flag to approximate eviction interactions. The default report used for Cost Ops leaves that flag off to produce conservative estimates.

Samira Quinn: The rollback policy outputs a confidence score but I want to see the ROC curve for the estimator. Can we add a small eval harness output with thresholds so reviewers can tune sensitivity?
Priya Kapoor: Added a small 'eval_summary' section to the report with precision/recall at three sample thresholds. See tests that assert the values are present.
Tom Nguyen: CI spike on integration flaked once with timeouts; please add a retry wrapper to the e2e runner.
Priya Kapoor: Added retry and a 30s backoff on the e2e invocation; CI run green now.

release_notes: Add 'prefill-auditor' CLI to validate prefill/batching/caching defaults and safe quantization rollouts. Provides deterministic replay reports with latency, token-cost deltas, and a rollback policy generator. Opt-in behind feature flag. Useful for Cost Ops and SRE teams to gate default changes.
test_plan: Run 'make test-integration-prefill' locally to validate replay, run 'cmd/prefill-auditor --sample examples/prefill/tenant-sample.json --policy examples/prefill/policy.json' to generate a report. CI will run integration and unit tests; check telemetry/metrics.yaml for expected metrics.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated with 'prefill_auditor' flag. Telemetry emits 'prefill.auditor.run' and 'prefill.rollback_candidate' metrics. The CLI writes reports to /tmp/prefill-reports by default and includes a stable JSON shape for audit ingestion.
migration_instructions: No DB schema migration required. Config added as a JSON profile in pkg/quant/quant_profiles.json which is loaded at runtime. Operators should update config stores if they opt to adopt the generated rollback policies.
